description: MEMBERS: what X has been saying about one contract: posts naming the address in their text, distinct accounts, combined reach, acceleration, and each poster's record on earlier calls. Needs a PumpPill membership: send Authorization: Bearer <claim>, the sign-in token on pumppill.org/premium. Reads X live before answering when the hourly budget allows (the live field says); the stored corpus is always underneath. A SAMPLE of X: zero means PumpPill saw none, and silence on an EVM contract is normal. Counts, reach and record; no sentiment or hype score. Each call may spend a live-read budget.
name: x_chatter
title: X chatter on a contract (members)
